title: John Lennon’s Bag One exhibition opens in Rome | 1971
content:
Bag One, John Lennon’s exhibition of erotic lithographs, opened on 21 October 1971 in Rome, Italy.

The lithographs, known collectively as Bag One, had been drawn by Lennon in 1969, and chronicled his wedding ceremony and honeymoon with Yoko Ono, and one of their bed-ins for world peace.

The Bag One Portfolio was published as a limited edition of 300, and contained 14 artworks. Similar exhibitions had opened in London (15 January), Detroit (21 January), Long Beach (28 January), New York City (7 February), Amsterdam (7 February), San Francisco (13 February), Toronto (14 February), Milan (20 February), Los Angeles (1 March), and Dusseldorf (14 March 1970).

The Rome exhibition ran from 21 October to 16 November 1971, more than a year after the other exhibitions, at the Galleria Ponte Sisto.
